title: Causal anchors, noncommuting order, and cold retention for numeric weight programming

parent.classification: exploratory negative/mixed; inherited not accepted science

question: Can learner-visible physical interventions identify separately grounded raw-acoustic meanings and distinguish ordered causal operations, allowing minimal-training numerical weight writing to generalize and retain knowledge better or cheaper than independent trained neural and strong symbolic comparators?
hypothesis: Directly constructed numerical association weights, with at most 64 fixed gradient warmup steps, can infer held-out action consequences from raw unsplit binary utterances under independently identifiable interventions and avoid the order-invariant shortcut. A scientific benefit requires predeclared accuracy, cost, capacity, retention and strong-control comparisons. A failure or tie at equal cost falsifies the claimed advantage.

source.type: new public synthetic deterministic source; no DEV or PRIMARY before final generator+comparator pin and independent admission
source.observation: raw undelimited binary acoustic stream; initial and final physical state; optional physical visual actuator indicators emitted by an actual charged intervention; outcome only after action; action/energy/reset receipt. No lexical codebook, segment boundaries, role labels, generator parameters, oracle triples or heldout outcomes enter any learner.
source.encoding: Independently keyed per-cohort SHA-256 counter PRNG with rejection sampling. Each world has a hidden prefix-free 4-6-bit codebook; word lengths and allowed max-three-word structure are a common explicitly supplied hypothesis prior for every learner. Identity/permuted/rotated encodings; no shared dictionaries between worlds.

families.anchored_effect: 8 distinguishable physical objects at 4 locations with a visible 3-state orientation register. Command means entity+destination+verb. Given observable before-state, a verb shifts location by offset 0,1,2 mod4 after choosing a destination, and independently changes orientation by a verb-specific delta modulo3. An orientation sensor is a physical anchor, not a verb label. Ambiguous no-change observations remain; all three fields affect the observable transition.
families.noncommuting_order: 8 distinguishable physical objects at 7 position states; each command chooses entity plus two ordered operators from one shared set of 4 unary physical operations: add1 mod7, multiply2 mod7, reset2, and negate mod7. Operations execute first then second. Grammar shifts between A and B. Both operator roles share vocabulary, so exchanging their acoustic order can change the physical consequence. Record paired reversed-order contrasts evaluated at matched initial states, with observable inequality required in source audits.

source.counts: Each family and fixture world has 48 charged Phase-A interventions + 12 charged Phase-B interventions (60 total), with no free probes or resets; both A and B heldout commands are disjoint from all demonstrated full raw streams. Each family includes explicit reversed-order evaluation pairs wherever its semantics permit. Exact heldout counts and source SHA must be frozen before first DEV.
source.source_leakage: Learners receive Observation records only. SourceWorld/latent triples/codebook/order/heldout labels are evaluator-owned. Assert forbidden imports/constructor args and causal interventions cost one observed action each.
source.source_qualification: Before DEV, prove at least one independent physically distinguishable action for every anchored-effect verb/destination relation, and material reverse-order differences for a preregistered fraction >=25% of eligible noncommuting swapped commands; if structural audit fails mark INVALID, not a scientific negative.

splits.cohort_isolation: Separate keyed codebooks and event streams by family, cohort, seed, encoding and phase; SELFTEST is engineering only and cannot establish scientific generalization; protected PRIMARY first use requires separate admission.

arms.pure_direct: Zero-gradient observed-consequence numerical write/readout with bounded candidate raw-stream partitions, candidate semantic addresses and conflict-driven abstention. No prewired true word mapping or evaluator grammar.
arms.warm64_direct: Exactly 64 deterministic gradient steps on observed physical consequences (no oracle word labels), using learned address weights to route evidence into the same numeric write/readout mechanism, without veto-only readout.
arms.count_only: Same candidate partitions, observable actions and numeric effect writes as direct construction, selecting candidate addresses by observed-frequency support rather than gradient; include equal-budget random-address control.
arms.conventional: Independent fully trained raw-bit recurrent or state-space neural learner, at most 65,536 parameters, at most 20,000 update steps, fixed early-stop based only on train-side splits and a held-in non-DEV tuning subset. If unconverged, report comparator INCOMPLETE and do not claim advantage.
arms.symbolic: Independent evidence-consistent full-codebook segmentation+grammar+transition hypothesis search over supplied prior; include all plausible complete worlds or abstain when node/memory caps preclude exhaustiveness. No oracle labels, bit codebook, task generator imports or hidden tuples.
arms.lookup: Exact demonstrated full-stream input-to-outcome table; no compositional extrapolation.
arms.oracle_ceiling: Evaluator-only upper bound, not a fair learner comparator.

budgets.environment: 60 distinct charged interventions per family/fixture; identical source order and physically visible observations for each arm; no gratuitous active queries, resets, hidden replay or changing action budget.
budgets.learning: warm64 exactly 64 updates; pure/count/symbolic/lookup zero gradients; conventional max 20,000 optimizer steps and frozen convergence check.
budgets.search: before DEV, specify hard finite node, memory and wall-time caps for every search arm; exhaustion means abstention/INCOMPLETE, never guessed correctness.
budgets.memory: report persistent bits (raw numeric weights, candidate hypotheses, readout logic metadata, memorized experiences, optimizer state), code/interpreter bytes, and cold-restore size; mark unmatched capacity clearly. No cost-superiority claim without matched capacity or explicit Pareto frontier.
budgets.compute: measure full wall-clock, CPU time, peak resident memory, hypothesis enumeration counts, learning steps, total inference, observation cost and cold restore. Include both compilation/construction and inference.

metrics.primary: Exact held-out physical next-state prediction under original and changed grammar, plus cold restored replay and independent order-sensitive swapped-pair accuracy.
metrics.secondary: Abstention rate and wrong-confident rate; separate lexical/role/effect generalization; action count, whole-process CPU seconds, memory bits, inference latency and energy surrogate.
metrics.retention: Phase-A heldout prediction after Phase-B learning and after cold restore; preserve conflicts and unrelearned facts.
metrics.negative_controls: Unknown raw binary strings, reversed-order noncommuting pairs, syntactic permutations without evidence, contradictory consequences, swapped physical sensor fields, sham/zero-write, and tampered snapshots.

gates.dev: Only after source hash, complete comparator implementations, fixed split, frozen search and training budgets, resource cost measurement, source isolation and full tests are committed. DEV must record all failures and uncontrolled advantages.
gates.engineering: Focused structural/negative/cold-restore tests; exact-source G29 atlas; inherited WSP01-WSP52 full Linux+Windows regression; pin candidate SHA and source tree. CI engineering pass is not science pass.
gates.primary: One independent admitted first-use of sealed PRIMARY source on exactly frozen candidate; no tuning or reruns for favorable outcomes.
gates.science: At least 85% unseen A exact state, 75% changed-grammar B, 95% retained A, 100% cold restore on observed facts, zero wrong-confident under ambiguity; >=5pp joint accuracy gain over strongest fully-qualified conventional OR symbolic baseline at no higher whole-process cost and capacity, OR within 1pp at <=50% whole-process cost and no poorer negative/retention. Must also pass >=80% of eligible order-sensitive contrast pairs. Otherwise MIXED/NEGATIVE or INCOMPLETE, never an AGI claim.
gates.accept: Scientific first-use, owner acceptance, loop integration, protected ref updates and merge are separate and not authorized by this protocol.

stop_rules: Do not inspect or derive PRIMARY outcomes before independent admission
No post-result threshold, seed, source, model or early-stop tuning
If a family is not physically identifiable from observations, mark source INVALID or ambiguity-ABSTAIN as preregistered
Preserve WSP52 negatives, do not relabel them as WSP53
If strongest control not converged or exhaustive search not complete, do not claim competitive superiority
Keep raw output metrics for every family, seed and encoding; no selective exclusions
